text: What if your down payment kept working?
Buy a car, a bike or a home and make your down payment.
It goes into a transparent USD-C vault on Stellar.
The vault earns yield from vetted on-chain sources.
Every month, the yield sweeps to your lender as extra principal.
That lowers your effective payment or pays your loan down faster.
Track it all in the app.
And at payoff, your deposit comes back to you.
For dealers and lenders, it helps close more deals with the same lien and title process.
Quasaria Autopay – down payments that keep working.
